comparison.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create a polished large landscape visual comparison board titled exactly "POWER AGENTS — SPRITE DIRECTIONS", subtitle "Concept exploration / choose an art direction". Three equal columns LEFT TO RIGHT labelled exactly "A · ARCADE SENTAI", "B · COMMAND DIORAMA", "C · POCKET SENTAI". Reference1 is A's character pair and setting; Reference2 is B's pair and setting; Reference3 is C's pair and setting. Use each supplied character design and setting in the corresponding column. Preserve the distinguishing proportions, costumes, monster design, weapon silhouette and perspective. Warm pale ivory matte presentation background, very restrained dark navy dividers. Upper row in each column: the isolated red ranger and corresponding horned armored monster together on a plain pale ivory surface, complete uncropped bodies/weapons; generous whitespace around them; same relative actor scale between columns, monster1.2x ranger height. Lower row each column: corresponding supplied environment vignette as a wide thumbnail. Footer each column: six solid square palette swatches, respectively A #172033 #D93438 #FF7157 #FFF1D2 #376586 #EAB64E, B #192C32 #AF3544 #D9E7D8 #52717A #8CC6B4 #D0A558, C #28243F #EC4055 #FF926B #FFF0C9 #666AB0 #75CBB1. Under swatches labels exactly A "Heroic / bold / arcade", B "Tactical / calm / diorama", C "Compact / playful / idle RPG". Bottom line exactly "Concept art — not animation-ready sprites". Keep titles and labels outside character-image areas, no text covering characters. Crisp pixel-art and clean graphic-design presentation, comparable spacing, useful large samples, readable typography. No additional characters, fake UI or health bars. Large landscape canvas with enough vertical space for both rows.
